title: RunManifest (M4 + M4B)
description: Run bundle manifest. M4B extends the M4 manifest with `save_schema_version`, `delta_baseline_cadence_ticks`, and `ledger_chain_anchor` (optional, tournament-mode only).

save_schema_version.description: M4B § 'Replays survive a game update': the SaveSchemaVersion this run was recorded under, as [major, minor, patch]. Defaults to `[2, 0, 0]` for legacy bundles.

delta_baseline_cadence_ticks.description: M4B § 'Delta baseline cadence is enforced': ticks between baseline snapshots in the run bundle. Default 600 (10 s @ 60 Hz).

ledger_chain_anchor.description: M4B § 'Tamper-evident competitive replays': BLAKE3 chain anchor of the final event in the run. Set in tournament mode; null in dev mode.
